data.name: Sanctions Screening

name.description: Full legal name of the entity or individual to screen.

entity_type.description: Filter by entity type. Use 'any' unless you have high confidence the target is strictly one.

lists.description: Subset of lists to check. Omit for ALL.

threshold.description: Minimum fuzzy match score (0-100) to report as a hit. 85 = good KYC default; 70-80 for exploratory sweeps; 92+ for high-precision gating.

refresh.description: Force re-download even if cache is fresh.

also_check_aliases.description: Additional names/spellings to also screen (e.g. trading names, Cyrillic/Arabic transliterations).

name.description: Full legal name of the person to screen.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. 'GB', 'US', 'DE') of the country where the screened party resides or operates. Biases Wikidata + enables government-roster check.

also_check_aliases.description: Additional spellings, maiden names, patronymics, transliterations.

former_pep_lookback_months.description: How far back to still flag someone as Former PEP after leaving office. 18 months is FATF's common guidance; EU requires 'at least 12 months'. Set 0 to drop former PEPs entirely.

sources.description: Which sources to query. Omit for ALL.

data.name: Adverse Media
data.description: Negative-news screening fused from Tavily, GDELT, Google News RSS, and direct Reuters/FT scrapes — auto-categorised by FATF risk type (bribery, ML, fraud, sanctions evasion, etc.) with source-tier weights

search_depth.description: Tavily search depth. 'advanced' costs more tokens but surfaces deeper results.

name_match_threshold.description: Drop hits whose title fuzzy-match is below this.

min_source_weight.description: Require at least this source-tier weight (1-5).

data.name: UBO Discovery

company_name.description: Legal name of the entity to investigate.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'GB', 'PL', 'NL'). Strongly recommended — massively reduces false positives in the GLEIF/OpenCorporates matches.

lei.description: Pre-known LEI if you have it — skips name disambiguation.

registration_number.description: Pre-known local registration number (e.g. UK company number, KRS number).

ubo_threshold_pct.description: Minimum effective ownership % to classify a natural person as a UBO. Defaults 20 (EU AMLD-6). Use 25 for FinCEN CTA, 10 for UK PSC strict / enhanced DD.

max_depth.description: Max ownership-tree depth to walk. 4 is enough for most private groups; 6+ for complex holding structures.

sources.description: Subset of sources to query. Defaults to ALL.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. 'PL', 'GB', 'IR') OR full country name.

signals.description: Subset of signals to fetch; 'all' by default.

data.name: Legal Existence Verifier
data.description: Verify a company is legally registered and in good standing — cross-references GLEIF, OpenCorporates, UK Companies House; auto-detects shell patterns, dissolved/struck-off, LEI lapses

registration_number.description: Pre-known local company number — reduces ambiguity.

lei.description: Pre-known LEI — skips GLEIF name search.

data.name: KYC Scorer
data.description: Deterministic aggregator — takes CPI rank + annual notional + industry + signal flags, outputs MET-style Indicator I/II/III scores, aggregated score, and Simplified/Standard/Enhanced check type

annual_notional_usd.description: Expected annual contracted volume or notional in USD.

industry_segment.description: Industry key — use one of: arms_defence, gambling_casinos, crypto_vasp, mining_extractives, oil_gas, shipping_maritime, cash_intensive_retail, money_service_business, real_estate, precious_metals_stones, construction, telecoms, energy_trading, wood_furniture_paper, manufacturing, wholesale_distribution, professional_services, agriculture, utility_regulated, public_sector, education, healthcare_regulated, technology_saas, insurance_regulated, banking_regulated, other. Free-text also accepted — we'll fuzzy match.

sanctions_hit.description: Has a sanctions match been found?

pep_match.description: Is the counterparty or UBO a PEP / family / associate?

ubo_discovery_gaps.description: Count of unresolved UBO chain gaps.

name.description: Legal name of person or entity to screen.

area.description: Country/bidding zone code (e.g., DE_LU, FR, ES, IT, NL, GB)

data.description: UK electricity + EU ETS carbon prices, renewable generation mix, grid decarbonisation data

data_type.description: Type of data. 'carbon_price' is a compatibility alias that returns carbon INTENSITY (gCO2/kWh) — Ember doesn't serve ETS prices. 'power_price' returns electricity demand (Ember doesn't serve wholesale prices either).

year.description: Year for data (e.g., 2024). If omitted, defaults to last 12 months.

data.name: ECB Rates
data.description: European Central Bank — FX reference rates, euro-area yields, HICP inflation series

data.name: Yahoo Finance
data.description: Universal Yahoo Finance reader — one tool for every instrument. Actions: stock_price, company_info, earnings, dividends, economic_indicator (FRED), commodity_future, fx_rate, list_aliases. Friendly aliases (gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper, wti, brent, natgas_henry_hub, natgas_ttf, corn, wheat, usdcny, eurusd, vix, sp500 ...) map to Yahoo symbols. Save (action, args) bundles as named presets in /admin/tool-presets so any agent or app can pull the same configured feed by preset slug.

action.description: stock_price/company_info/earnings/dividends for equities; economic_indicator for FRED (needs FRED_API_KEY); commodity_future for any commodity by alias or =F symbol; fx_rate for FX (alias or =X symbol); list_aliases returns the named-alias dictionary.

symbol.description: Stock ticker (AAPL), FRED series (GDP, UNRATE), Yahoo future (CL=F, GC=F, NG=F), FX (CNY=X, EURUSD=X), or friendly alias (gold, wti, brent, natgas_henry_hub, natgas_ttf, corn, usdcny). Run action=list_aliases to see them all.

history_days.description: Optional shortcut for commodity_future: window in days. Overrides period when set.

data.name: Options Market Data
data.description: Listed options-market signals: at-the-money implied volatility, 25-delta risk reversal (call IV minus put IV — captures skew), put/call open-interest ratio, term-structure slope, and a four-bucket regime label (calm / nervous / skewed-up / skewed-down). Works on any ticker with a Yahoo option chain — futures (CL=F, NG=F, GC=F), indices (^SPX, ^VIX), equities (AAPL, MSFT), FX (EURUSD=X). Three actions: snapshot, term_structure, regime.

action.description: snapshot: ATM IV + skew + OI for one expiry. term_structure: front three expiries' IV + slope. regime: calm/nervous/skewed-up/skewed-down label.

symbol.description: Yahoo ticker. Futures with =F (CL=F crude, NG=F natural gas), indices with ^ (^SPX, ^VIX), equities plain (AAPL), FX with =X (EURUSD=X).

data.name: EIA Open Data
data.description: US Energy Information Administration time series — Mont Belvieu propane, WTI/Brent spot, Henry Hub gas, US LPG exports. Real, regulator-published, every value cites a series id.

series_id.description: Shortcut id (PROPANE_USGC_MB, WTI_SPOT, BRENT_SPOT, HH_NATGAS, US_LPG_EXPORTS, PROPANE_USA) or raw EIA v2 path.

data.name: Open-Meteo Weather
data.description: Free weather + marine forecasts (no API key) for any lat/lon or pre-mapped energy hubs (Houston, Rotterdam, Singapore, Chiba, Ras Tanura, etc.). Mode='atmosphere' for wind/temp/precip; mode='marine' for wave height + swell + SST.

location.description: Hub shortcut id or empty if lat/lon set

data.name: AIS Live Vessels
data.description: Sample real-time global vessel positions from AISStream.io. Every MMSI in the response is a real ship that can be looked up on VesselFinder. Filter by bounding box and ship-type code (84 = LPG tanker). Requires AISSTREAM_API_KEY env var (free registration at aisstream.io).

data.name: Bunker Fuel + Freight Estimate
data.description: Public bunker-fuel reference (VLSFO at Houston/Rotterdam/Singapore/Fujairah/Tokyo/New York) plus a corridor freight-rate ESTIMATE (bunker-derived, not Baltic-assessed). Pass origin+destination to get a $/MT freight quote for a typical VLGC voyage. Production deployments swap to a Baltic Exchange feed for assessed rates.

origin.description: Houston / Rotterdam / Singapore / Fujairah / Tokyo / New York

data.name: Vessel Specs + Density
data.description: Vessel-class registry (VLGC/MGC/LGC/SGC for LPG, VLCC/Suezmax/Aframax/LR2/LR1/MR2/MR1/Handysize for CPP) plus product density table (propane/butane/ammonia/naphtha/gasoline/jet/ULSD/gasoil/fuel-oil/crude/methanol). Five actions: vessel (spec card), density (kg/L for product), convert (m^3<->MT or $/MT<->$/bbl), capacity (MT a class lifts for a named product), list (every vessel or product). Single source of truth for freight math; every freight-touching agent should pull from here.

action.description: vessel: spec card. density: kg/L for a product. convert: unit conversion (m^3<->MT or $/MT<->$/bbl). capacity: MT a vessel class lifts for a named product. list: enumerate classes or products.

vessel_class.description: VLGC, MGC, LGC, SGC, VLCC, Suezmax, Aframax, LR2, LR1, MR2, MR1, Handysize

product.description: propane, butane, ammonia, lpg_mix, naphtha, gasoline, jet, ulsd, gasoil, fuel_oil, crude_wti, crude_brent, methanol

data.name: Refined Products Forwards + Cracks
data.description: Refined-products forward curves + crack spreads from Yahoo continuous futures. Pulls RB=F gasoline, HO=F ULSD/heating oil, CL=F WTI, BZ=F Brent, NG=F Henry Hub. Three actions: curve (front-month settle), crack_spread (3-2-1 or product-vs-crude in $/bbl), history (N days of daily settles). No API key required.

product.description: rbob/gasoline, heating_oil/ulsd/diesel/gasoil, wti/crude_wti, brent/crude_brent, natural_gas, propane, naphtha

data.name: Worldscale Freight (CPP)
data.description: Worldscale freight calculator for clean-products tankers. Knows the 2025 flat-rate schedule for the main TC routes (TC1 MEG->Japan naphtha, TC2 Cont->USAC gasoline, TC5/6/7/14/17). Computes freight in $/MT as ws_points/100 * flat_rate. Three actions: route (look up flat rate + freight), voyage_cost (full $ given cargo size), list.

route_code.description: TC1 / TC2 / TC5 / TC6 / TC7 / TC14 / TC17

ws_points.description: Worldscale points quoted by broker (e.g. 180 means WS180).

cargo_mt.description: Override cargo size in MT (default uses route's standard).

data.name: Baltic BLPG (LPG)
data.description: Baltic Exchange BLPG indices for LPG freight: BLPG1 (Ras Tanura->Chiba), BLPG2 (Houston->Flushing), BLPG3 (Houston->Chiba via Panama) in $/MT propane VLGC. Curated Q1-2026 OPEC-MOMR levels; production sets BALTIC_API_KEY+BALTIC_API_URL env to swap to the live subscription feed. Two actions: route (single BLPG mid/low/high), all (all three side-by-side).

data.name: Port Constraints (UN/LOCODE)

Three actions: port (full spec card), list (enumerate all), check (vessel_class + locode -> compatible/borderline/incompatible with breakdown of draught, LOA, beam, air-draught, product handling).

locode.description: UN/LOCODE — e.g. USHOU, NLRTM, SGSIN, JPYOK

vessel_class.description: VLGC, MGC, VLCC, Suezmax, Aframax, LR2, LR1, MR2, etc.

product.description: Optional — confirms the port handles this product (lpg, gasoline, diesel, etc.).

data.name: Atlas — Describe
data.description: Summarise an Atlas graph (counts by kind, top edge labels, most-connected concepts) so the agent has a map of the domain before drilling in.

data.name: Atlas — Pattern Query
data.description: Pattern-match nodes in an Atlas graph by label-like + kind. Returns structured rows; the typed alternative to vector search.

label_like.description: Substring to match the node label (case-insensitive).

patterns.description: One or more node patterns to match.

graph_id.description: Optional. UUID of the atlas graph to query. Defaults to the agent's primary atlas.

data.name: Atlas — Traverse
data.description: Return the 1-hop neighbourhood of a node in an Atlas graph (incoming + outgoing edges). Use after locating a concept to walk to related concepts.

data.name: Atlas — Grounded Search
data.description: Find KB documents bound to concepts near a target term in the ontology. Better than vector-only when chunks must be tied to a typed concept.

data.name: Atlas — Cypher (read-only)
data.description: Run a read-only Cypher query against the Atlas knowledge graph. CREATE/MERGE/DELETE/SET/REMOVE/CALL apoc/LOAD CSV are rejected by a server-side validator. Tenant + graph context are injected automatically. Row cap 1000, timeout 10s.

data.name: Atlas — As-Of (bi-temporal)
data.description: Query the Atlas graph as it existed at a specific timestamp. Uses the bi-temporal edge columns (valid_from / valid_to) for audit, compliance, and 'what did we know on date X' agent workflows.

instructions.description: Additional extraction guidelines, e.g. 'Focus on financial terms. Use ISO dates. Extract ALL clauses, not just the first few.'

model.description: LLM model to use for extraction

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens for the LLM response

operation.description: list_records | get_record | search | get_summary | get_related | compare_field | discover_fields | query_fields

data.description: News / social sentiment scoring for markets, counterparties, or topics — aggregates multiple sources with source-tier weights

formula.description: Expression using parameter names and basic math operators (+, -, *, /, **, min, max, abs). Example: "revenue * (1 - tax_rate) - costs"

scenarios.description: Named scenario presets with parameter overrides. Example: [{"name": "bull", "overrides": {"revenue": 1500000}}]
